description: This header file declares functions for converting object files between different hash algorithms within a repository context, including methods to map object IDs and perform conversions.

methods.name: repo_oid_to_algop
methods.description: Converts an object ID within a repository to a specified hash algorithm, producing a destination object ID.

methods.name: convert_object_file
methods.description: Converts an object file from one hash algorithm to another, returning success or failure.
